DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • Summon Gargoyle is active with ≤22 seconds remaining.
  • They have Army of the Dead talented and either Raise Abomination active with <18 seconds remaining or Army Ghouls active with ≤18 seconds remaining.
  • Dark Transformation is active if they lack both Summon Gargoyle and Army of the Dead talents.
  • Dark Transformation is active in non-Gargoyle builds (even with other talents).
  • Summon Gargoyle is unavailable and its cooldown exceeds Power Infusion's duration by >10 seconds.
  • Facing ≥3 enemies during Dark Transformation or while Death and Decay is active.
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when:

  • Voidform is active and Power Infusion isn’t currently applied
  • Dark Ascension is active and Power Infusion isn’t currently applied
  • The Shadow Priest has the TWW 4-piece tier set bonus active and Power Infusion isn’t currently applied
